title: Compiled vs. Interpreted: Short Answer
instructions: Reminder: compiled code is translated ahead of time; interpreted code is translated while it runs. C# is a hybrid because it uses intermediate bytecode and just-in-time compilation.

questions.prompt: In your own words, what is the difference between a COMPILED language and an INTERPRETED language?
answers: A compiled language is translated ahead of time into machine code before it runs. An interpreted language is translated while the program runs.
